newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 9.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Oct 9:
WASHINGTON - USAir Inc. is in talks with its pilots union over creation of a low-cost operation between the Northeast and Florida to compete with a similar service by Delta Air Lines Inc.
WASHINGTON - Two professors won the Nobel prize in economics for separate work describing how people and institutions make choices when they don't share the same information.

WASHINGTON - The enforcement division of the National Association of Security Dealers accused a marketmaker, Sterling Foster & Co. of defrauding customers of $53 million in three initial public offerings in 1995.
WASHINGTON - Longtime bulls are growing nervous about the shrinking number of pessimists on Wall Street.
WASHINGTON - GRC International Inc. has hired an investment bank to examine the possibility of selling itself or merging with another company.
